summary: First full pass on Plantagenet Players theatre app. 27 pytest cases (26 pass, 1 was a test-side casing assertion — fixed). Frontend flows verified: public nav (5 pages), shows listing, admin login->/admin dashboard KPIs, all admin subroutes (shows, members, tickets, email, fixtures) render, member login->/portal, member->/admin correctly redirects to /portal, unauthenticated /portal redirects to /login, Stripe checkout successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com with a real cs_test session, seed data (4 shows + 6 fixtures + admin + demo member) present.

minor.issue: Route is declared BEFORE the SPONSORS list is defined in server.py, and it references the module-level SPONSORS constant. Since the constant is defined at import time in the same module this happens to work, but the route ordering is confusing / fragile — recommend moving @api.get('/sponsors') below SPONSORS list.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is loaded once at import; empty secret causes construct_event to reject all events. Fine for sandbox but should be documented.

ui_bugs.issue: Subject and Message inputs lack data-testid (only email-send-btn has one). Add data-testid="email-subject" and "email-body" for robust E2E.

issues: Browser tab title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be updated to 'Plantagenet Players' in public/index.html for branding.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="email-subject" and data-testid="email-body" to inputs in AdminEmail.jsx.
OPTIONAL: Update public/index.html <title> from generic Emergent placeholder to 'Plantagenet Players'.
OPTIONAL: Reorder /api/sponsors route to after SPONSORS list definition for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~740 lines; still manageable but consider splitting routers (auth, shows, payments, admin) into separate modules if the file grows further.

get_current_user reads cookies OR Bearer header — good, but /auth/logout only deletes cookie; frontend actually stores JWT in localStorage 'pp_token' and clears it client-side. This dual auth surface works but is inconsistent; pick one.
issue_tickets is called from both webhook and status polling — idempotent via find_one(session_id) check. Good.

payment_transactions status polling uses stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve on every /payments/status call until paid — acceptable but rate-limits could bite in a burst; consider adding short-circuit if updated_at is very recent.
All admin endpoints correctly use require_admin dependency; member correctly gets 403. Verified in tests.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded by backend on startup: 1 admin, 1 demo member, 4 shows (1 current, 2 upcoming, 1 past), 6 lighting fixtures. Tests also created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed users/shows/fixtures/campaigns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, shows, admin shows CRUD, payments (checkout + status), membership apply, admin (stats/members/tickets/transactions/fixtures/campaigns), authorization. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Stripe checkout is verified up to redirect only (not actual card entry — that requires an interactive Stripe UI which is out of scope for automation).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All identified items are low-priority polish (missing testids on 2 inputs, browser tab title, minor code organization).
